notes.title: Update! 1.2.3
notes.content:
Quite a few updates!

-Puzzle updates for 2-9, 7-9 and 8-8
-Enable "Tap to hold" in settings to disable click and drag
-Use the mouse wheel to rotate pieces 
-Learn some German!

Thank you everyone for your feedback and suggestions!  Here at LCG, [i]you[/i] are royalty to us!

notes.title: Update Notes - Release Day Patch
notes.content:
Thanks so much to everyone who has played Plungeroo on the day of it's release! And thank you for reporting a few issues that you found.  Please let me know if you encounter any other bugs and I will try to address them promptly

This patch includes:
-Spanish added
-esc button update
-flavor text fix
-World  scrolling/Level select fix
-achievement bug (?) Please let me know if this is still an issue
